title: Can You Bend Just the TIP of Your Finger? 👆
description:
Point your finger and try to bend only the tip. Did the middle joint bend too? The tip has no string of its own: one string (a tendon) from a muscle in your forearm bends your fingertip, and on the way it runs right across the middle joint, so pulling it folds both. Now hold the middle joint still with your other hand and try again: there it goes, only the tip bends.
Did only the tip bend? Yes or no?

Bonus: that is exactly how hand doctors check that tendon. They hold your middle joint straight and ask you to bend the tip.
